name: Crimson Spotify
description: Spicetify integration for Crimson Desktop: theme, Crimson custom app, Full App Display, crimson-core bridge.

spicetify.install_source: https://github.com/spicetify/cli/releases (official release tarball spicetify-<ver>-linux-<arch>.tar.gz; sha256 checked against GitHub's published asset digest when available)
spicetify.not_used: install.sh — it ends by piping the Marketplace installer into sh, which this project does not do
spicetify.latest_release_seen_during_research: v2.44.0 (2026-07-05, adds Spotify 1.2.93 support) — the installer always resolves the current latest release and records the exact version

components.name: Crimson (theme)
components.license: same as the Crimson Desktop repository
components.purpose: palette via --spice-* variables, hairline frames, active/hover states, pixel headings, playback bar, Full App Display styling; theme.js = crimson-core bridge client + live profile classes

components.name: Crimson (custom app)
components.license: same as the Crimson Desktop repository
components.purpose: sidebar page: synced lyrics from crimson-core (line / karaoke / word mode), shared per-track offsets, real CAVA spectrum, now-playing info

components.name: Full App Display
components.author: khanhas (Spicetify)
components.version: the version bundled with the installed Spicetify release
components.purpose: immersive full-window now-playing: large art, title/artist/album, release date (Spotify's own album metadata via Spicetify.GraphQL), progress, controls
components.disable: crimsonctl spotify disable  (or: spicetify config extensions fullAppDisplay.js- && spicetify apply)

evaluated_and_not_installed.name: lyrics-plus (built-in custom app)
evaluated_and_not_installed.reason: Musixmatch provider is on by default with a hard-coded shared user token, and it can use Spotify's internal lyrics endpoint; it would also duplicate crimson-core's LRCLIB lookups and cache. The Crimson app uses crimson-core instead.

evaluated_and_not_installed.name: Popup Lyrics (built-in extension popupLyrics.js)
evaluated_and_not_installed.reason: Providers include Spotify's internal color-lyrics endpoint (spclient.wg.spotify.com), Musixmatch's desktop API with a user token and a third-party Netease proxy.

evaluated_and_not_installed.name: Spicetify Marketplace
evaluated_and_not_installed.reason: Not required; its documented installer is a remote script piped into sh, and it would let unreviewed extensions be added outside this manifest.

evaluated_and_not_installed.name: Community visualizer custom apps
evaluated_and_not_installed.reason: Not verified here; in-client visualizers can only use playback metadata, not live audio. Real audio visualization stays in crimson-core (CAVA/PipeWire) and is shown in the Crimson app and dashboard.

bridge.precedent: Spicetify's built-in webnowplaying.js connects to ws://localhost:8974
